### Watch a Shiny ExtendedTask

`watch_mascot_task()` binds a `shiny::ExtendedTask` to a mascot with built-in
defaults for `"initial"`, `"running"`, `"success"`, and `"error"`. Pass `map`
only for the keys or fields you want to change:

```{r watch_mascot_task-call, echo = FALSE}
htmltools::tags$pre(htmltools::tags$code(paste0(
  'review <- shiny::ExtendedTask$new(slow_review)\n',
  'obs <- mascot::watch_mascot_task(\n',
  '  "helper",\n',
  '  review,\n',
  '  map = list(\n',
  '    running = list(status = "Reviewing sample"),\n',
  '    error = list(bubble = mascot_bubble("Check the input.", duration = Inf))\n',
  '  )\n',
  ')\n',
  '# Call obs$destroy() if you need to stop watching before the session ends.'
)))
```

Before the task first runs (`"initial"`), the mascot keeps the mood and status
it starts with. An update is sent only when the task's status changes. An
empty `list()` for a key leaves the mascot unchanged in that state. Inside a
Shiny module, pass the module's local mascot id, the same as in
`update_mascot()`.

```{r watch_mascot_task-mistakes, echo = FALSE}
if (!in_studio()) guide_mistakes_html("watch_mascot_task", studio_character)
```
